description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity 'MultiPropertyAnimations' demonstrating various methods to animate multiple properties of a View in parallel, including ValueAnimator, ViewPropertyAnimator, ObjectAnimator, and PropertyValuesHolder.

classes.name: MultiPropertyAnimations
classes.description: An Activity class demonstrating multiple property animation techniques in Android.

methods.name: runValueAnimator
methods.description: Uses ValueAnimator to animate View's translation properties manually by updating their values on each animation frame.

methods.name: runViewPropertyAnimator
methods.description: Uses the ViewPropertyAnimator API for smooth, parallel animation of View properties.

methods.name: runObjectAnimators
methods.description: Creates separate ObjectAnimator instances for translation X and Y and starts them, potentially in parallel.

methods.name: runObjectAnimator
methods.description: Uses PropertyValuesHolder objects with a single ObjectAnimator to animate multiple properties simultaneously.
